en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

Yes, it is bad for one's mental health to stay
indoors all the time.

It's good to breathe fresh air, even if just
for a moment.

Can you feel how overjoyed your air
filter must be...!?
A healthy body houses a healthy mind.

In my case, proper maintenance is more
crucial to my health than exercise...

But I will join you, Shuichi! Let's see who
can keep the longest running pace!

Professor Idabashi has forbidden me from
prolonged exposure to sunlight.

<CLT=cltMIND>You're talking like you're a delicate
instrument or something...

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
